notablePrerequisites:
Trespasser's Curse attached to yourself.
You have a way to gain life.
You control at least two Fungi and/or Beasts.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
The Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Trespasser's Curse.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Trespasser's Curse trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
